name: geston-hosting
description: WhatsApp Bot Hosting Platform with TX Coins

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Primary admin account email (required). Must match a registered user email.

APP_URL.description: Public URL of this app (e.g. https://your-domain.com)

CLIENT_URL.description: Frontend public URL used for OAuth redirects and email links

PORT.description: HTTP listen port (Heroku sets this automatically)

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: API key for deploying bots (Account Settings → API Key). Also usable from admin AppSettings.

PAYSTACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional Paystack webhook secret for signature verification

PAYSTACK_NIGERIA_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Nigeria Paystack public API key (pk_live_...). Leave empty to disable Nigeria payments.

PAYSTACK_NIGERIA_SECRET_KEY.description: Nigeria Paystack secret API key (sk_live_...). Leave empty to disable Nigeria payments.

PAYSTACK_SA_PUBLIC_KEY.description: South Africa Paystack public API key (pk_live_...). Leave empty to disable SA payments.

PAYSTACK_SA_SECRET_KEY.description: South Africa Paystack secret API key (sk_live_...). Leave empty to disable SA payments.

PAYSTACK_GHANA_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Ghana Paystack public API key (pk_live_...). Leave empty to disable Ghana payments.

PAYSTACK_GHANA_SECRET_KEY.description: Ghana Paystack secret API key (sk_live_...). Leave empty to disable Ghana payments.

SPEEDPESA_API_KEY.description: SpeedPesa API key for Tanzania payments (x-api-key header). Set webhook URL to {APP_URL}/webhook/speedpesa in SpeedPesa dashboard.

WONYA_TOKEN.description: DRC WonyaPay token (leave empty to disable DRC payments)

TXH_API.description: Social media boosting provider API key

TXH_API_URL.description: Social media boosting provider API base URL

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP host for sending emails (default: smtp.resend.com)

SMTP_FROM.description: From address for login/reset emails. Defaults to Geston Hosting <noreply@gestontech.online> if unset.

BOT_OWNER_ID.description: A unique ID you choose to identify your own WhatsApp owner session in the database

DEV_WA_NUMBER.description: Owner personal WhatsApp number digits only with country code. Used for WA admin commands and Contact Developer. Do not use OWNER_NUMBER.

T_NUMBERS.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp numbers (digits + country code) allowed unrestricted AI (any topic, still identifies as Geston Hosting assistant). Not owner/admin powers. Example: 2547xxxxxxxx,2557xxxxxxxx

AI_MEMORY_TTL_HOURS.description: Hours to keep per-user AI chat memory in RAM before auto-clear (default 6)

WA_BOT_NUMBER.description: Public WhatsApp bot number digits only (landing/docs links)

DEV_NAME.description: Developer display name used in AI assistant replies (default Geston)

BRAND_NAME.description: Platform display name used in AI assistant replies (default Geston Hosting)

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key(s). Comma-separate multiple keys to rotate on quota/rate limits.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key(s) used as AI fallback when Gemini fails. Comma-separate to rotate.

VITE_DEV_WA_NUMBER.description: Vite build: Contact page WhatsApp digits. Must be set before build.

PANEL_API_KEY.description: Pterodactyl panel API key for provisioning servers

PANEL_EGG_ID.description: Pterodactyl egg id for panel provisioning

PANEL_NEST_ID.description: Pterodactyl nest id for panel provisioning

PANEL_EMAIL_DOMAIN.description: Email domain used when creating panel accounts

IMAGE_URL.description: Logo image URL shown in the app header and branding areas

PAIRING_URL.description: Optional pairing / session-ID page URL for the default bot template

KSH_PER_TX.description: Kenyan Shillings per 1 TX (used for refund/top-up displays)

MONGO_STORAGE_QUOTA_MB.description: Soft Mongo storage quota shown on admin Database page (default 512)
